title: Request
description: Things the agent is waiting on the user for. A request is open from request.opened until request.resolved, and is answered with a respond command. A thread's state keeps it once it's resolved, with its resolution.

ThreadRequest.description: A request, told apart by type: open, or resolved (with its resolution).

PermissionRequest.description: The agent wants to call a tool, and the permission policy said ask. Answered with outcome allow or deny.

tool_call_id.description: The tool_call item it's for, when there is one.

name.description: The tool's name, as in ToolCall.name.

input.description: The tool's arguments, as in ToolCall.input.

title.description: A short summary of what's asked, e.g. the command line.

reason.description: Why the harness asks, when it says.

parent_id.description: The subagent tool_call that's asking, if one is.

resolution.description: How it was resolved, once it is (request.resolved): the state keeps resolved requests with this set. Absent while it's open.

raw.description: The harness's own payload, for debugging.

QuestionRequest.description: The agent asks the user one or more questions (Claude's AskUserQuestion, Codex's requestUserInput). Answered with outcome answer.

tool_call_id.description: The tool_call item it's for, when there is one.

parent_id.description: The subagent tool_call that's asking, if one is.

resolution.description: How it was resolved, once it is (request.resolved): the state keeps resolved requests with this set. Absent while it's open.

raw.description: The harness's own payload, for debugging.

PlanRequest.description: The agent has made a plan and asks to start on it (Claude's ExitPlanMode; a proposed plan from Codex in plan mode). Answered with outcome allow, to start on it in the resolution's permission_mode, or deny, to keep planning, with the message as the user's feedback.

tool_call_id.description: The tool_call item it's for, when there is one.

parent_id.description: The subagent tool_call that's asking, if one is.

resolution.description: How it was resolved, once it is (request.resolved): the state keeps resolved requests with this set. Absent while it's open.

raw.description: The harness's own payload, for debugging.

id.description: Unique within the request; the key for its answer.

header.description: A very short label for it.

options.description: Choices. With none, the answer is free text.

multi_select.description: More than one option can be chosen.

allow_other.description: Free text is accepted as well as the options.

secret.description: The answer is a secret: don't show or log it.

label.description: The option's text, which is also its answer.

Resolution.description: How a request was answered: sent in respond, and repeated in request.resolved.

outcome.description: allow, deny: for a permission or a plan. answer: for a question. cancel: for any, when the user dismisses it or the turn ends first.

always.description: allow, deny, for a permission: apply the same answer to matching calls for the rest of the thread, without asking.

message.description: deny: why, which the agent is told (for a plan, the user's feedback on it). answer: a note with the answers.

permission_mode.description: allow, for a plan: the permission mode the thread carries on in, which it's set to. Left out (or plan), it's the thread's mode, or default if that's plan.

answers.description: answer: for each question id, the chosen option labels or the free text.
